postReview.title: Hull City 2-0 Manchester United: Ajayi and Mendy secure dream Premier League return
postReview.description: Newly promoted Hull City stunned Manchester United in their Premier League opener, scoring twice in a stunning first-half performance.

postReview.title: Hull City 2-0 Manchester United: Ajayi y Mendy sellan un regreso soñado a la Premier League

postReview.title: Hull City-Manchester United 2-0: Ajayi e Mendy firmano un ritorno da sogno in Premier League

postReview.title: Hull City 2 x 0 Manchester United: Ajayi e Mendy garantem retorno dos sonhos à Premier League

preReview.title: Preview: Hull City welcome Man United for season opener
preReview.description: Hull City have never defeated Manchester United in the Premier League, but will be determined to change that on their return to the Premier League.

preReview.title: Carrick: Rashford se ve ágil, fuerte y listo para jugar con el United

preReview.title: Carrick: Rashford è "brillante, forte e pronto a giocare" con il Manchester United
preReview.description: Marcus Rashford è tornato al Manchester United dopo il prestito al Barcellona e Michael Carrick è entusiasta di riaverlo a disposizione.
